title: Controlling Bleeding, Giving Fluids, and the Four Types of Shock
next: Chapter 22, Lesson 1: Wound Types, Healing, and the PCP Wound Assessment

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already use direct pressure, tourniquets and pelvic binding. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Find hidden bleeding, and control external bleeding in the BC order
  2. Tell the four types of shock apart at the bedside
  3. Match PCP care to each type, and know what's not on the licensing exam

Textbook: Chapter 21, PDF pages 1757–1807
slides.say: Welcome back. Last lesson covered why shock happens and what the PCP adds in the hypovolemia protocol. Today we build on that. As an EMR you already control bleeding with direct pressure, a tourniquet, and a pelvic binder, so we'll review the BC wording quickly. Then we'll spend most of our time on the four types of shock, because as a PCP your treatment depends on the type. The same fluid that saves one patient can hurt another. We'll also cover CPAP and PEEP in the heart failure protocol, the anaphylaxis protocol, and what isn't on your licensing exam, like needle decompression.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。上节课讲了休克为什么发生，以及 PCP 在低血容量流程里多做什么。今天在此基础上往前走。作为 EMR，你已经会用直接压迫、止血带和骨盆带止血，所以 BC 的流程措辞我们快速过一遍。然后把大部分时间放在四种休克上，因为作为 PCP，你的处置取决于休克类型：同样的补液，能救一个病人，也可能害了另一个。我们还会讲心衰流程里的 CPAP 和 PEEP、过敏流程，以及哪些执照考试不考，比如针刺减压。

slides.title: Finding the bleeding you can't see
slides.body:
• MOI is your best clue to internal bleeding
  • Shock, no obvious injury → suspect chest, abdomen or pelvis
  • Coffee-ground vomit, black tarry stool → upper GI bleed
  • Bright red blood in stool → lower bowel; blood in urine → kidney
  • Ask about aspirin, warfarin and other blood thinners
  • Older adults: dizziness or fainting may be the first sign
slides.say: Let's start with assessment. External bleeding is easy to see; the bleeding that kills is often hidden. Your best clue to internal bleeding is the mechanism of injury. If a patient has signs of shock but no obvious injury, assume bleeding inside the chest, abdomen, or pelvis. In medical patients, coffee-ground vomit or black, tarry stool points to bleeding high in the gut, and bright red blood in the stool points lower. Blood in the urine can mean a kidney injury. As a PCP, take a deeper history: ask about aspirin, warfarin, and other blood thinners. And in an older adult, dizziness or fainting may be the first sign of a hidden bleed.
slides.sayZh: 先讲评估。外出血一眼就能看到，真正要命的往往是看不见的出血。内出血最好的线索是受伤机制。病人有休克表现却找不到明显外伤，就要考虑胸腔、腹腔或骨盆内出血。内科病人呕吐物像咖啡渣，或者排黑色柏油样便，提示上消化道出血；大便带鲜红血，提示出血部位更低。尿里有血，可能是肾损伤。作为 PCP，病史要问得更深：问阿司匹林、华法林和其他抗凝药。老年人头晕或晕倒，可能是隐匿出血的第一个表现。

slides.title: BC bleeding control: the order
slides.body:
BC Wound Care protocol — every licence level

  • Start with direct pressure, then a pressure dressing and positioning
  • Still bleeding, on a limb → tourniquet proximal to the wound
  • Still bleeding, junctional (groin, armpit) → wound packing
  • Tourniquet: note the time and never release it
  • Packing (book's method): fill the cavity tightly, hold pressure ≥ 3 min

BC: do not pack wounds on the neck, chest or abdomen.
slides.say: Here's the BC Wound Care protocol for major bleeding. You know these skills, so focus on the wording. Start with direct pressure, then a pressure dressing and positioning. If direct pressure fails on a limb, apply a tourniquet proximal to the wound, which means closer to the heart. Note the time, and never release it. If the wound is in a junction, like the groin or armpit, where a tourniquet won't fit, consider wound packing. The book's method is to fill the cavity tightly with gauze and hold firm pressure for at least three minutes. One BC rule to memorize: never pack a wound on the neck, chest, or abdomen.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 伤口处理流程里的大出血部分。这些技术你都会，重点记措辞。先直接压迫，再用加压敷料、摆放体位。肢体伤口直接压迫止不住，就在伤口近心端上止血带，也就是靠心脏的一侧；记下时间，绝不松开。伤口在交界区，比如腹股沟或腋窝，止血带上不去，就考虑伤口填塞。书里的做法是用纱布把伤腔紧紧塞满，用力按压至少三分钟。有一条 BC 规定要背下来：颈部、胸部、腹部的伤口一律不填塞。

slides.title: Pelvic binder: the BC rules
slides.body:
Bind the pelvis before transport: a major mechanism plus any of

  • HR > 100 or systolic < 90
  • Pelvic pain or instability on exam
  • Decreased level of consciousness
  • A major injury distracting from the pelvic exam

Not for hip (neck-of-femur) fractures or simple falls from standing. Centre on the greater trochanters; no zap straps; don't roll the patient.
slides.say: Now the pelvic binder. A broken pelvis can hide a large bleed, and binding closes the ring so the bleeding slows. In BC, bind the pelvis when a major mechanism suggests a pelvic fracture, plus any one of these: a heart rate over one hundred or a systolic under ninety, pelvic pain or instability, a decreased level of consciousness, or another major injury distracting from the exam. Don't bind a hip fracture, meaning a broken neck of the femur, or a simple fall from standing. Use a commercial binder or three overlapping broad triangular bandages, centred on the greater trochanters. No zap straps, and don't roll the patient.
slides.sayZh: 接下来是骨盆带。骨盆骨折可以藏住大量出血，绑住骨盆能让骨盆环闭合、减慢出血。在 BC，受伤机制重大、提示骨盆骨折，再加上以下任意一条，就要绑骨盆：心率超过一百或收缩压低于九十；骨盆疼痛或不稳；意识水平下降；或有其他重伤干扰骨盆检查。髋部骨折，也就是股骨颈骨折，以及站立高度的普通跌倒，不要绑。用商品骨盆带，或三条重叠的宽三角巾，中心对准股骨大转子。不能用扎带，也不要翻动病人。

slides.q: A man has a deep stab wound in the groin. Direct pressure, a pressure dressing and positioning haven't stopped the bleeding. Under the BC Wound Care protocol, what is the best next step?
options: Apply a tourniquet just above the wound
Pack the wound tightly with gauze and hold pressure
Elevate the leg and keep holding pressure
slides.say: Quick check. A man has a deep stab wound in the groin. Direct pressure, a pressure dressing and positioning haven't stopped the bleeding. Under the BC Wound Care protocol, what's the best next step? A, apply a tourniquet just above the wound. B, pack the wound tightly with gauze and hold pressure. C, apply a pelvic binder. D, elevate the leg and keep holding pressure. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 小测一下。一名男子腹股沟有很深的刀刺伤，直接压迫、加压敷料和摆放体位都没能止住血。按 BC 伤口处理流程，下一步最好怎么做？A 在伤口正上方上止血带；B 用纱布把伤口紧紧填塞并持续按压；C 上骨盆带；D 抬高下肢、继续按压。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. The groin is a junctional area, so there's no limb above the wound for a tourniquet. BC says to consider wound packing when direct pressure fails and a tourniquet won't fit. A won't work for that reason. C treats a pelvic fracture, not an open groin bleed. D only repeats positioning, a step that has already failed.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。腹股沟是交界区，伤口上方没有肢体可以上止血带。BC 规定：直接压迫无效、又上不了止血带时，考虑伤口填塞。A 正因为这个原因行不通；C 是处理骨盆骨折的，不是处理腹股沟开放性出血；D 只是重复已经失败的摆放体位这一步。

slides.title: Four types of shock at the bedside
slides.body:
TypeBedside cluePlan
Hypovolemicpale, cool, clammy; a source of lossstop the loss, replace volume
Cardiogenicheart history, chest painlisten to the lungs; careful with fluid
Distributivehives and wheeze, or warm dry skin + slow pulsefill the pipes, treat the cause
Obstructivetension pneumo, tamponade, big PEremove the block

Can't tell? Treat it as hypovolemic first (textbook).
slides.say: Last lesson you sorted shock by what fails. Now let's use that at the bedside, because each type needs a different plan. Hypovolemic: pale, cool, clammy skin, a fast pulse, and a source of loss. Stop the loss and replace volume. Cardiogenic: a heart history or chest pain. Listen to the lungs and go carefully with fluid. Distributive: hives and wheezing in anaphylaxis, or warm, dry skin and a slow pulse after a spinal injury. Fill the wide pipes and treat the cause. Obstructive: remove the block; fluid only buys time. And if you can't tell, the book says treat it as hypovolemic first.
slides.sayZh: 上节课你按「哪里出问题」给休克分了类。现在把它用到床边，因为每一型的处置都不一样。低血容量性：皮肤苍白湿冷、脉快，有明确的丢失来源；处置是止住丢失、补回容量。心源性：有心脏病史或胸痛；要听肺，补液要谨慎。分布性：过敏时有荨麻疹和喘鸣，脊髓伤后则是皮肤温暖干燥、脉搏慢；处置是填满扩张的血管，并治疗病因。梗阻性：要解除堵塞，补液只能争取时间。如果判断不了，书上说先按低血容量处理。

slides.title: Hemorrhagic shock: fluid is a bridge
slides.body:
Stop the bleeding first; fluid is only a bridge

  • Bleeding control comes before fluid: think CABC
  • Normal saline or Ringer's lactate; no dextrose fluids in trauma
  • About 60% of a saline bolus leaves the vessels within 20 min
  • Book: small boluses, aim for perfusion, not a normal BP
  • Pulse > 120, systolic < 90, penetrating MOI → call ahead for blood
slides.say: For hemorrhagic shock, the book is clear: control the bleeding before you think about fluid. It writes CABC, with bleeding control in front of the ABCs. As a PCP you'll resuscitate trauma with isotonic crystalloid, normal saline or Ringer's lactate, never a dextrose solution. Fluid is only a bridge: about sixty percent of a saline bolus leaks out of the vessels within twenty minutes. So the book suggests small boluses aimed at signs of perfusion, like a radial pulse or a patient who can talk, not a normal blood pressure. If the pulse is over one hundred twenty, the systolic is under ninety, or the injury is penetrating, call ahead: this patient may need blood.
slides.sayZh: 出血性休克，书上讲得很清楚：先止血，再考虑补液。书里写成 CABC，把控制出血放在 ABC 前面。作为 PCP，创伤复苏用等渗晶体液，也就是生理盐水或乳酸林格液，绝不用含葡萄糖的液体。补液只是过渡：一次推注的生理盐水，大约百分之六十会在二十分钟内渗出血管。所以书里建议小剂量分次推注，目标是灌注的征象，比如摸得到桡动脉、病人能说话，而不是把血压拉到正常。如果脉搏超过一百二十、收缩压低于九十，或者是穿透伤，要提前通知医院：这个病人可能需要输血。

slides.title: Cardiogenic shock: the CHF protocol
slides.body:
BC CHF / Pulmonary Edema protocol — its indications include cardiogenic shock

  • All levels: rest, sit upright with legs down, keep warm
  • All levels: O₂ to SpO₂ ≥ 94%; assist if LOC altered or SpO₂ < 94%
  • PCP, on scene: consider CPAP
  • PCP: PEEP valve on the BVM, starting at 5 cmH₂O
  • CPAP is contraindicated if systolic < 90; PEEP off if systolic < 90

This protocol has no fluid bolus. The book allows a 250 mL trial only if the lungs are clear.
slides.say: Cardiogenic shock means the pump is failing, so extra fluid can flood the lungs. In BC, the protocol for congestive heart failure, or CHF, and pulmonary edema lists cardiogenic shock as an indication. Every licence level keeps the patient at rest, sitting up with legs down and warm, gives oxygen to ninety-four percent or higher, and assists ventilations if needed. The PCP adds two tools on scene: CPAP, continuous positive airway pressure, and a PEEP valve, for positive end-expiratory pressure, on the bag-valve mask, starting at five centimetres of water. The catch: CPAP is contraindicated when the systolic is under ninety, and PEEP comes off below ninety. And this protocol has no fluid bolus.
slides.sayZh: 心源性休克是泵在衰竭，多给液体可能把肺淹了。在 BC，充血性心衰（CHF）和肺水肿流程把心源性休克列为适应证之一。所有执照级别都要：让病人休息、坐直双腿下垂、保暖、给氧使血氧达到九十四以上，必要时辅助通气。PCP 在现场多了两样工具：CPAP，也就是持续气道正压；以及在球囊面罩上加 PEEP 阀，也就是呼气末正压阀，从五厘米水柱开始。关键在这里：收缩压低于九十时禁用 CPAP；收缩压掉到九十以下，PEEP 阀也要拿掉。而且这个流程里没有补液推注。

slides.title: Distributive shock: three kinds
slides.body:
Anaphylactichives, wheeze, swellingairway can close
Septicinfection + systolic < 90leaky capillaries
Neurogenicwarm, pink, dry skin; slow pulseafter spinal cord injury

Don't confuse neurogenic shock (low BP) with spinal shock (loss of movement and reflexes — not true shock).
slides.say: Distributive shock means the vessels open too wide, so a normal blood volume can't fill them. Know three kinds. Anaphylactic: after an allergen, the patient develops hives, wheezing, and swelling that can close the airway. Septic: an infection plus a systolic under ninety, or a drop of more than forty from baseline. The capillaries leak, so fluid escapes and can collect in the lungs. Neurogenic: after a spinal cord injury, the vessels lose their nerve signals, so the skin is warm, pink, and dry, and the pulse is relatively slow, not fast. Don't confuse this with spinal shock, which is a loss of movement and reflexes, not a true circulatory shock.
slides.sayZh: 分布性休克是血管扩张过度，正常的血量装不满。要认识三种。过敏性：接触过敏原后出现荨麻疹、喘鸣，以及可能堵住气道的肿胀。脓毒性：感染加上收缩压低于九十，或比基础值下降超过四十；毛细血管渗漏，液体跑出血管，还可能积在肺里。神经源性：脊髓损伤后血管失去神经信号，所以皮肤温暖、粉红、干燥，脉搏相对慢而不是快。不要和脊髓休克混淆：脊髓休克是运动和反射的丧失，不是真正的循环休克。

slides.q: A 70-year-old with heart failure is awake, breathing 32/min, SpO₂ 86% on oxygen, crackles in both lungs. BP 84/52. You are the PCP. What about CPAP?
options: Start CPAP at 5 cmH₂O right away
Hold CPAP: systolic under 90 is a contraindication. Give oxygen, assist ventilations if needed, transport
Give a 2 L fluid bolus first, then start CPAP
Start CPAP at 10 cmH₂O to push fluid out of the lungs
slides.say: Here's a PCP decision. A seventy-year-old with heart failure is awake, breathing thirty-two times a minute, saturation eighty-six percent on oxygen, with crackles in both lungs. Blood pressure eighty-four over fifty-two. What about CPAP? A, start CPAP at five centimetres of water right away. B, hold CPAP, because a systolic under ninety is a contraindication; give oxygen, assist ventilations if needed, and transport. C, give a two-litre fluid bolus first, then start CPAP. D, start CPAP at ten to push fluid out of the lungs. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。一位七十岁的心衰病人神志清醒，呼吸每分钟三十二次，吸氧下血氧百分之八十六，双肺有湿啰音，血压八十四比五十二。CPAP 怎么办？A 立即上 CPAP，五厘米水柱；B 暂不用 CPAP，因为收缩压低于九十是禁忌证，给氧、必要时辅助通气、转运；C 先补液两升，再上 CPAP；D 直接上十厘米水柱的 CPAP，把肺里的液体压出去。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. This patient meets most CPAP indications, but BC lists a systolic under ninety as a contraindication, so A is wrong. C is wrong because the CHF protocol has no fluid bolus, and wet lungs can't handle two litres. D ignores the low pressure, and CPAP starts at five, not ten. If you need to bag this patient, a PEEP valve also comes off when the systolic is under ninety.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。这个病人符合大部分 CPAP 适应证，但 BC 把收缩压低于九十列为禁忌证，所以 A 错。C 错在心衰流程里没有补液推注，肺已经湿了，承受不了两升液体。D 忽略了低血压，而且 CPAP 从五开始，不是十。如果需要用球囊面罩通气，收缩压低于九十时，PEEP 阀同样要拿掉。

slides.title: Obstructive shock: remove the block
slides.body:
• Tension pneumothorax, cardiac tamponade, massive PE
  • Vena cava compressed in late pregnancy
  • Fluid may buy time — it doesn't remove the block
  • Open chest wound: three-sided occlusive dressing or chest seal
  • Signs of tension → lift a corner to let the air out
  • Tamponade → rapid transport to the ED

Licensing exam: no needle decompression for EMRs or PCPs (BCEHS PCPs: after added-scope Schedule 2 training).
slides.say: Obstructive shock happens when something blocks the flow: a tension pneumothorax; a cardiac tamponade, which is blood squeezing the heart inside its sac; a massive pulmonary embolism; or the vena cava compressed late in pregnancy. Fluid may buy a little time, but it won't fix the block. The book teaches needle decompression for a tension pneumothorax, but it isn't on the BC licensing exam for EMRs or PCPs; BCEHS PCPs may do it after added-scope training. On the exam, follow the Chest Trauma protocol: seal an open chest wound with a three-sided occlusive dressing or a chest seal, watch closely for tension, and if it develops, lift a corner to let the air out. For tamponade, the answer is rapid transport.
slides.sayZh: 梗阻性休克是血流被堵住了：张力性气胸；心包填塞，也就是心包里的血压迫心脏；大面积肺栓塞；或者孕晚期腔静脉受压。补液也许能争取一点时间，但解除不了堵塞。书上教张力性气胸做针刺减压，但执照考试里，EMR 和 PCP 都不考这项操作；BCEHS 的 PCP 经扩展范围（Schedule 1/2）培训后可以做。考试时你要按胸部创伤流程做：开放性胸伤用三边封闭敷料或胸部封贴封住，密切观察有没有张力征象，一旦出现，掀开一角放气。心包填塞的答案是快速转运。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: shock beyond bleeding
slides.body:
BC CHF, Anaphylaxis and Chest Trauma protocols

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • CHF: sit upright, O₂ to ≥ 94%, assist ventilations
  • Anaphylaxis: supine, don't walk them, remove the allergen
  • Anaphylaxis: epinephrine IM
  • Chest: three-sided seal; relieve it if tension develops
  • Chest: manually stabilize a flail segment

PCP adds

  • CHF, on scene: CPAP; PEEP 5 cmH₂O on the BVM
  • Anaphylaxis: IV + 20 mL/kg (max 2 L) if still hypotensive
  • Anaphylaxis: salbutamol after epinephrine; diphenhydramine
  • Chest, en route: IV if required; TXA if indicated
slides.say: Here's how your job changes across three protocols. On the left, every licence level. In CHF, sit the patient up, give oxygen to ninety-four percent, and assist ventilations. In anaphylaxis, lay the patient flat, never walk them, remove the allergen, and give epinephrine intramuscularly. In chest trauma, seal open wounds, relieve the seal if tension develops, and hold a flail segment by hand. On the right, the PCP adds CPAP and PEEP for heart failure. In anaphylaxis, an IV and twenty millilitres per kilogram of fluid, up to two litres, if the patient stays hypotensive, plus salbutamol after the epinephrine, and diphenhydramine. In chest trauma, an IV and TXA, tranexamic acid, en route, when indicated.
slides.sayZh: 这张图看三个流程里你的工作怎么变。左边是所有执照级别都做的。心衰：让病人坐起、给氧到九十四、辅助通气。过敏：平卧、绝不让病人走动、去除过敏原、肌注肾上腺素。胸部创伤：封住开放伤口，出现张力就给封贴放气，用手固定连枷胸段。右边是 PCP 多做的：心衰用 CPAP 和 PEEP。过敏如果持续低血压，开静脉、按每公斤二十毫升补液、最多两升，在肾上腺素之后用沙丁胺醇，再加苯海拉明。胸部创伤在途中开静脉，有指征时给 TXA，也就是氨甲环酸。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Running fluid? Listen to the lungs before and after each 500 mL
  • CPAP: not if systolic < 90, trauma, pneumothorax, vomiting, age ≤ 12
  • Anaphylaxis: epinephrine first; the other drugs don't replace it
  • Neurogenic shock: warm skin and a slow pulse don't mean "stable"
  • On the licensing exam, epinephrine is IM only; vasopressors aren't on the exam list
slides.say: Now the new watch-outs. One: whenever you run fluid, listen to the lungs before you start and after every five hundred millilitres. New crackles mean the lungs are getting wet, so stop and rethink, especially in a heart patient. Two: know the CPAP contraindications, including a systolic under ninety, a traumatic cause, a suspected pneumothorax, vomiting, and age twelve or under. Three: in anaphylaxis, epinephrine comes first; salbutamol and diphenhydramine never replace it. Four: in neurogenic shock, warm skin and a slow pulse can fool you into thinking the patient is stable. Five: on the licensing exam, BC epinephrine is intramuscular only, and the book's vasopressors aren't on the exam drug list.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲新的注意事项。一，只要在补液，开始前听一次肺，之后每五百毫升再听一次。出现新的湿啰音，说明肺在变湿，要停下来重新考虑，心脏病人尤其如此。二，记住 CPAP 的禁忌证，包括收缩压低于九十、创伤导致的呼吸困难、怀疑气胸、呕吐、十二岁及以下。三，过敏时肾上腺素永远第一，沙丁胺醇和苯海拉明绝不能代替它。四，神经源性休克时，皮肤温暖、脉搏慢，很容易让你误以为病人稳定。五，执照考试里 BC 的肾上腺素只能肌注，书里的升压药也不在考试药物清单上。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Packing: the book includes the neck → BC: never neck, chest or abdomen
  • Binder: BC excludes hip fractures and simple falls from standing
  • Tension pneumothorax: no needle decompression on the exam → relieve the seal
  • Cardiogenic shock: book lays them flat → BC CHF: sit up, legs down
  • Fluids: book uses 250 mL steps → BC: 20 mL/kg, max 2 L, every 500 mL
  • Epinephrine: book also uses it for the heart → BC exam: IM only
slides.say: Let's line up where the book and BC differ, because on the exam, BC wins. The book lists the neck as a place you might pack; BC says never pack the neck, chest, or abdomen. BC also excludes hip fractures and simple falls from standing from pelvic binding. The book teaches needle decompression; on the BC exam you relieve the dressing instead. The book lays a cardiogenic shock patient flat; the BC CHF protocol sits them up with legs down. The book gives fluid in two-hundred-fifty-millilitre steps; BC uses twenty millilitres per kilogram, up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred. And on the exam, BC epinephrine is intramuscular only.
slides.sayZh: 把书和 BC 的不同之处排一排，因为考试时以 BC 为准。书把颈部列为可以填塞的部位；BC 规定颈部、胸部、腹部一律不填塞。BC 还规定髋部骨折和站立高度的普通跌倒不绑骨盆。书上教针刺减压；BC 执照考试里你要做的是给敷料放气。书上让心源性休克病人平卧；BC 心衰流程让病人坐起、双腿下垂。书上按每次二百五十毫升补液；BC 是每公斤二十毫升、最多两升、每五百毫升复评一次。还有，执照考试里 BC 的肾上腺素只能肌注。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Bleeding: tourniquet on a limb, packing in a junction; never pack neck, chest, abdomen
  2. Match care to the type: fill an empty tank, spare a weak pump, remove the block
  3. Know the limits: no CPAP/PEEP if systolic < 90; exam: epi IM only, no needle decompression

Next: Chapter 22, wound types, healing, and the PCP wound assessment
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: for bleeding, start with direct pressure. If that fails, use a tourniquet on a limb or packing in a junction, and never pack the neck, chest, or abdomen. Two: match your care to the type of shock. Fluid helps an empty tank or wide pipes, a weak pump needs caution and lung checks, and an obstruction needs the block removed, usually by fast transport. Three: your PCP tools have limits. No CPAP or PEEP with a systolic under ninety, and on the licensing exam, epinephrine intramuscular only and no needle decompression. Next time we start Chapter twenty-two, soft-tissue injuries. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，止血先直接压迫；压不住，肢体上止血带，交界区做填塞，颈部、胸部、腹部绝不填塞。二，处置要和休克类型对上：容量不够或血管太宽，补液有用；泵衰竭要谨慎、反复听肺；有堵塞就要解除堵塞，通常靠快速转运。三，PCP 的工具有边界：收缩压低于九十不用 CPAP 和 PEEP；执照考试里肾上腺素只肌注，也不考针刺减压。下节课开始第二十二章，软组织损伤。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
